claims.statement: Tom Allen attended a quoits game between Dr. Truman of St. Louis and G. Knowles at Sam Swancut's in West Belleville, on April 8, 1883.
claims.excerpt: Tom Allen, ex-pugilist, was present and Was made alion of by the sporting community.
